trigger: a reader relies on the ledger being append-only
summary: Commit 009da1a1f changed one row (sre-audit-persist-alert-description-omits-route, open to linked-to-#7027) in place and re-serialised the file, against SKILL.md's 'a row is superseded, never edited'. The other eight rows differ only in JSON separators. Adjudicated by the lead: not a policy floor, because the append-only rule is stated in the skill and is not one of the three closed floor sources (routed-row catastrophic clause, CLAUDE.md invariant block, accepted ADR). The fragment has never left this machine and git history keeps the old row. The correction to recorded_at in 72d2fb0730 follows the same pattern for the same reason (a superseding row cannot beat a future-dated stamp). Not fixed.
classification_rationale: process rule departed from; content correct
